candidate.answerReason: The field has area 80 square meters. The unreachable central rectangle measures 8 by 6 meters and has area 48, leaving a reachable fraction of 32/80 = 2/5.

methods.label: Subtract the unreachable rectangle
methods.explanation:
The unreachable middle is a rectangle, so subtracting its area avoids counting the corner portions of the border twice.

The whole field has area
\[
10\cdot8=80\text{ square meters}.
\]
The unreachable rectangle begins \(1\) meter inward from each edge. Its length loses \(1\) meter at both ends, and so does its width. Its dimensions are therefore
\[
10-2=8\text{ meters},\qquad 8-2=6\text{ meters}.
\]
Its area is \(8\cdot6=48\) square meters, leaving \(80-48=32\) square meters that Peter can reach. The reachable fraction is
\[
\frac{32}{80}=\boxed{\frac25},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
